inotifywait -m -e close_write --format '%f' "$WATCH_DIR" | while read FILENAME
do
 case "$FILENAME" in
 *.pdf) ~/.shortcuts/move_pdfs_to_intake.sh ;;
 *.jpg|*.png) ~/.shortcuts/move_images_to_intake.sh ;;
 esac
done
Technical RisksRace Conditions: If your move_pdfs script starts moving a file while it's still being downloaded, the PDF header check (is_pdf_header) will fail. Using close_write in the watcher script prevents this.Permission Scoping: On Android 14+, ~/.shortcuts might require explicit MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE permissions.
